$comment: configs/profiles.json's weights: priority decides WHICH casualty to serve,
profile weights decide WHICH route to fly. priority = w_s*severityScore +
w_u*urgency + w_f*feasibilityScore, each term in [0,1], so priority is in [0,1].
Created in Phase 6 -- the first phase that actually computes priority; the
formula and these exact defaults were already specified in OPTIMIZATION_MODEL.md
§7 in Phase 0, but no config file existed to back them until now.
